title: Define Kanbus/Tactus orchestration contracts
description:
Document and enforce the boundary between Kanbus and Tactus. Kanbus owns issue state, claims, workspaces, validation, commits, pushes, PRs, and run records. Tactus owns deterministic procedure flow and bounded agent turns inside the capabilities Kanbus provides.

Acceptance:
- Architecture note exists in the repo.
- Contract is represented in config and tests.
- The default worker cannot infer or mutate global Kanbus state outside its assigned issue.
